decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Eldrazi creatures and powerful spells to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like All Is Dust, Kozilek's Command, and The One Ring, the deck aims to wipe the board of threats and maintain board advantage. Through the Breach allows for surprise creature plays, while Ancient Stirrings helps to find key cards. Emrakul and Ulamog are the big finishers, supported by Sowing Mycospawn and Devourer of Destiny. The mana base is built around Eldrazi Temple and various lands to support the Eldrazi creatures and spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to control the board through cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison, while also utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy revolves around playing aggressive creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Amped Raptor to deal damage quickly, supported by cards like Guide of Souls and Ocelot Pride to maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of The One Ring and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provides additional win conditions and board presence.

The main idea of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. By efficiently countering threats, removing key creatures, and drawing extra cards, the deck aims to maintain control of the game until it can deploy powerful threats like Murktide Regent to close out the game. The deck also includes disruptive creatures like Harbinger of the Seas and Psychic Frog to further disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also using lands like Watery Grave and Polluted Delta to ensure consistency in mana production.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Force of Negation, while also maintaining card advantage with Archmage's Charm and Preordain. The inclusion of creatures like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters provide additional threats on the board, while cards like Fatal Push and Sink into Stupor help to deal with opposing creatures. This Dimir Control deck focuses on manipulating the game to its advantage through a mix of disruption and card advantage.

The primary focus of this deck is to efficiently ramp up mana using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to quickly cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck also utilizes control spells such as Kozilek's Return and Kozilek's Command to disrupt opponent's strategies. Malevolent Rumble and Sowing Mycospawn provide additional removal and board control. The overall strategy is to overwhelm opponents with massive Eldrazi creatures while maintaining control over the game through spell interaction and ramping up mana.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful Eldrazi creatures and control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while ramping up to play huge threats quickly. By using cards like Through the Breach and The One Ring to cheat out high-cost Eldrazi like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Ulamog, the Defiler, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats. Additionally, cards like All Is Dust, Kozilek's Command, and Ugin's Labyrinth provide additional control elements to disrupt the opponent's board state and buy time to set up the game-winning plays.

The deck focuses on using ramp spells and mana acceleration to quickly cast big Eldrazi creatures, such as Emrakul and Ulamog, to control the game and overwhelm the opponent. It also utilizes cards like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's strategy and clear the board. The deck is designed to dominate the mid to late game with powerful threats and resource denial, ensuring victory through sheer brute force and strategic disruption.

The deck focuses on using efficient mana rituals and ramp spells to quickly generate mana and cast powerful spells like Goblin Charbelcher and Sundering Eruption to deal huge amounts of damage and win the game in a single turn. The combo potential is increased with cards like Recross the Paths and Irencrag Feat, allowing for explosive plays and quick victories. The lack of lands in the deck means it relies heavily on its spells to generate mana and win the game, making it a high-risk, high-reward strategy.

This deck focuses on combining instant speed reanimation effects like Goryo's Vengeance with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Ulamog, the Defiler to surprise and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Solitude and Ephemerate to protect your combo pieces, as well as disruption like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to control the game, the goal is to quickly assemble a game-winning board state. The deck also includes ways to tutor for key pieces and manipulate the graveyard, creating a versatile and resilient combo strategy.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's actions while efficiently managing resources. It utilizes a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures like Murktide Regent to control the pace of the game. By drawing cards, countering threats, and removing key threats from the board, this deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory through attrition. The versatile spell selection and mana base allow for adaptability and flexibility in responding to various threats and strategies.

This deck focuses on reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Ulamog quickly using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Fallaji Archaeologist. It also utilizes cards like Ephemerate and Solitude for protection and disruption. Thoughtseize helps to clear the way for the combo to go off smoothly, while Leyline Binding and Tainted Indulgence provide additional control and graveyard hate. Atraxa, Grand Unifier enhances the deck's synergy with its proliferate ability, allowing for more value from the powerful creatures being reanimated. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with big threats.

This deck focuses on building a strong board presence quickly by playing aggressive creatures and using burn spells to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to ramp up early game aggression with efficient creatures like Nishoba Brawler and Territorial Kavu, while also using cards like Leyline of the Guildpact and Stubborn Denial to protect your creatures. The deck also utilizes the Multicolored theme to take advantage of Tribal Flames and Scion of Draco for additional damage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and relentless assault.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, aiming to deal damage as quickly as possible to win the game. By utilizing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, the deck aims to consistently apply pressure to the opponent. The inclusion of Underworld Breach and Mishra's Bauble helps to generate card advantage and maintain momentum in the late game. Overall, this deck relies on speed and efficiency to outpace the opponent and secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It also utilizes the "Companion" mechanic with Jegantha, the Wellspring to provide additional mana acceleration. The deck includes disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt opponents' game plans, while also featuring powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Guide of Souls. The deck aims to put early pressure on opponents and finish games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using Eldrazi Temple and other ramp cards to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. It utilizes control elements such as All Is Dust and Kozilek's Return to disrupt opponent's strategies while also having access to Boseiju for protection against counter spells. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive Eldrazi creatures and control the board until victory is achieved.

The main idea behind this deck is to aggressively ramp into powerful Eldrazi creatures using cards like Through the Breach and Ancient Stirrings, while also controlling the board with spells like Kozilek's Command and All Is Dust. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with massive threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Ulamog, the Defiler, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Sowing Mycospawn. The deck utilizes a mix of ramp, control, and powerful finishers to dominate the late game and secure victory.
